title: Make session deletion crash-durable
description: Fix rust/ffi/src/sessions.rs so deletion creates a durable per-session pending-deletion marker before any mutation, recovers incomplete deletions before public session operations, fences stale writers, validates all marker paths fail-closed, and removes the marker only after index and artifacts are durably absent.
design: Add CheckedStorage pending-deletions directory and marker helpers parallel to pending-forks. Preflight all recovery entries before mutation. Recover deletions before pending forks so deletion supersedes fork publication cleanup. Keep tombstones in the in-memory lifecycle registry.
acceptance_criteria: Strict red-first fault-injection tests cover artifact removal and fsync failures, marker creation failures, symlink/malformed markers, retryability, pending-fork integration, and writer fencing; focused and full Rust gates pass.
notes: Strict TDD: initial pending_deletion suite ran 13 tests with 12 expected failures and 1 existing success; marker-rollback writer-fence regression then failed independently. Green: 14/14 focused pending-deletion tests; full Rust workspace 162 passed, 1 ignored; cargo check, clippy -D warnings, and fmt check passed. Recovery preflights all deletion/fork entries, processes deletions first, skips duplicate fork IDs, and retains deletion tombstones.
close_reason: Implemented durable pending-deletion markers, deterministic recovery, stale-writer fencing, fail-closed path validation, and fault-injection coverage; all Rust gates passed.

title: Chat surface wired to the agentic query loop (tool-call cards, stop/retry)
description: FFI session-scoped agentic loop with sandbox-safe file-tool allowlist; stream tool-call events; SwiftUI chat with tool cards, stop, retry. https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven-pocket/issues/2
close_reason: Closed

title: Bound Familiar roster and sidecar memory
description: Prevent Familiar roster and identity data from exhausting memory. Add bounded streaming roster decoding, centralized identity field validation, metadata-first bounded sidecar I/O, and validation at session/fork/companion boundaries using strict TDD.
acceptance_criteria: Roster rejects entry 257 while streaming; identity fields enforce documented byte limits; sidecars are capped before allocation and deletion remains recoverable; invalid identities never reach Swift or prompt preambles; focused and full Rust gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented bounded streaming roster decode, centralized identity limits, bounded sidecar I/O/recovery, and source-safe fork validation in commit 5d44a27; focused and full Rust gates pass.

title: Retain failed authentication cleanup
description: Logout or invalidated stale-login cleanup can fail after credentials were persisted, leaving the app visually signed out without a durable retry path. Publish and persist cleanup-required state, retry it independently, gate startup account publication, and expose an accessible SpikeView action.
design: Inject a boolean-only cleanup marker store into EngineClient. Route stale-login, logout, startup, and explicit retry through one generation-safe serialized engine logout path. Hide account/models/auth URL while cleanup is required and expose a SpikeView retry control.
acceptance_criteria: Strict TDD covers stale-login failure, retry success/repeated failure, startup success/failure with persisted marker, auth serialization, logout failure, and later clean login. Focused and full simulator tests, strict SwiftLint, and generic build pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified durable authentication cleanup retry, startup gating, and accessible UI action

title: Fence EngineClient operation state
description: Fix stream, OAuth, and model-load operation races with generation tokens and strict async callback tests. Preserve app-wide EngineClient and avoid Rust/generated/dependency changes.
acceptance_criteria: Overlapping sends are single-flight; Codex callbacks are fenced by generation/profile; auth and model-load generations prevent stale publication; focused and full requested gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified operation generation fencing for streams, OAuth, and model loads.

title: Disable multiple app scenes
description: Add a red host-bundle configuration regression test, configure XcodeGen generated Info.plist with UIApplicationSceneManifest.UIApplicationSupportsMultipleScenes=false, and verify focused/full simulator tests plus generic build and built plist.
acceptance_criteria: Host app Bundle test fails before config change and passes after; built CovenPocket.app Info.plist reports UIApplicationSupportsMultipleScenes=false; no true override remains; simulator suite, generic build, and SwiftLint pass; commit uses requested message and excludes .beads/xcodeproj.
close_reason: Implemented and verified single-scene Info.plist configuration regression

title: Fix ChatSession stop cancellation race
description: ChatSession::run_turn claims busy before awaiting messages/persistence but installs its cancellation token afterward, so stop/reset can cancel the previous token and the turn can continue into model/tool edits. Install the current token atomically with the busy claim under the synchronous cancel mutex, honor cancellation after setup, preserve exactly one terminal callback, and cover message-lock, persistence-lock, immediate-stop, concurrent-send, and fresh-next-turn races with strict TDD.
acceptance_criteria: Focused regression tests fail before the production change and pass after it; no model/tool loop starts after stop during setup; concurrent busy send does not replace active token; cancellation reports one on_done(cancelled), clears busy, and a later turn succeeds; full Rust test/check/clippy/fmt and existing Swift stale-session tests pass; no ABI/generated/dependency changes.
notes: Root cause: run_turn published busy before installing the current cancellation token, with messages.lock() and persist_new() awaits in between. Fix lock order is cancel mutex -> busy swap -> fresh token install; release before messages mutex -> persistence lifecycle/state locks. RED: cargo test -p coven-pocket-ffi chat::tests failed 5 new tests, each receiving end_turn instead of cancelled. GREEN: focused chat tests 33/33; full Rust 252 passed, 1 ignored plus check/clippy/fmt; four ChatModel stale reset/stop tests passed; code review found no significant issues. Commit a63c5d1.
close_reason: Implemented and verified in a63c5d1

title: Queue differing routed resets
description: Fix RoutedResetRunner so reset requests coalesce only by captured ChatBackend identity, queue a differing backend behind an active reset, make waiters span the queued reset, preserve cancellation-independent MainActor cleanup, update ChatView capture, add strict TDD regressions, run requested gates, and commit without staging .beads.
acceptance_criteria: Companion/Codex sequences satisfy coalescing and A/B/A ordering; routed waits span queued reset; cancellation does not cancel active/pending work; requested focused/full/lint/build gates pass; commit message is fix(chat): queue differing routed resets.
close_reason: Implemented and verified backend-aware routed reset queueing

title: Share account state across windows
description: Fix confirmed multi-window gap by moving EngineClient ownership to CovenPocketApp, keeping per-window ChatSurfaceState reset on shared profile transitions, and covering identity/recreation/auth fencing via strict TDD.
acceptance_criteria: Two windows share one EngineClient; A-to-B resets each per-window on-device state exactly once while companion survives; same profile is a no-op; new windows use current account; focused/full tests, SwiftLint, and generic build pass.
close_reason: Shared EngineClient ownership across WindowGroup roots with per-window account transition resets, auth fencing, stale model-load protection, and verified tests/build/lint.

title: Bound fork transcript staging
description: Fix fork_session_unlocked so every regenerated entry uses Pocket's exact bounded durable append path. Add strict TDD coverage for overflow, cumulative boundary, exact-fit success, rollback uncertainty, sidecar/source preservation, and keep standard fork behavior.
close_reason: Implemented bounded durable fork transcript staging with overflow, cumulative-boundary, near-limit success, and uncertain rollback recovery coverage; full Rust gates pass.

title: Fix cross-daemon Familiar prompt retry
description: Bind failed Companion prompt retries to normalized FamiliarProfileKey; preserve original identity only on same verified endpoint, safely rebind to the current valid selection after endpoint changes, retain actionable retry state otherwise, fence async endpoint switches, preserve cleanup and polling pinning, and add strict TDD coverage.
close_reason: Implemented and verified normalized cross-daemon Familiar retry rebinding, launch fencing, cleanup/polling pinning, UI context wiring, and regression coverage.

title: Fix cross-account chat state
description: ChatView and SpikeView currently own separate EngineClient instances. Codex login/logout changes global Rust credentials through Playground while Chat can retain account-scoped live ChatModel and Familiar state. Share one RootView-owned client and make profile-ID transitions reset on-device live state generation-safely without killing companion sessions.
design: RootView owns @StateObject EngineClient and injects it. ChatView observes it and delegates profile-ID changes to an injectable coordinator that invalidates route/session generation, stops stale in-flight sessions, and synchronizes Familiar profile state. CompanionChatModel is excluded from Codex-only resets.
acceptance_criteria: Root and children share EngineClient identity; A→B and A→nil reset on-device chat and route state once; nil→B cannot adopt stale work; same profile ID does not reset; companion session survives; Familiar snapshots remain per-account; focused and full gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented root-owned shared EngineClient and persistent chat transition fencing with TDD coverage; focused/full simulator tests, SwiftLint, and generic build pass.

title: Provision fresh-install session storage
description: Implement bounded two-level provisioning for the configured session storage root: validate all ancestors through the grandparent, create at most the immediate parent and root, durably sync grandparent then parent on every open, rollback per component with combined errors, and cover fresh iOS storage plus failure/restart cases with strict TDD.
design: Use path-based no-follow validation before and after each one-component mkdir/fsync. Provision immediate parent against existing grandparent first, then root against parent; never create above the parent or sync above the grandparent.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh Library fixture provisions Application Support and chat-sessions in exact order; missing/symlink ancestors fail without mutation; parent/root fsync failures rollback component-specifically and surviving components are re-synced on retry; existing paths sync only grandparent and parent; Rust tests/check/clippy/fmt pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified bounded two-level session storage provisioning

title: Require existing storage root parents
description: Replace permission-based ancestor resync with a structural storage-root rule: every ancestor through the immediate parent must already exist as a real directory without symlinks; only the final root component may be created, followed by immediate-parent fsync. Preserve rollback/retry durability and artifact gating.
design: Validate ancestors no-follow; reject missing or symlinked intermediates without creation. Create only final root, fsync only its immediate parent, and fsync that parent on every open when root already exists. Keep descriptor-relative symlink TOCTOU documented.
acceptance_criteria: Strict TDD covers missing intermediate rejection, mkdir then immediate-parent sync, rollback failure restart retry, iOS-shaped path with no ancestor sync, intermediate symlink rejection, and parent sync on every existing-root open. Full Rust test/check/clippy/fmt pass.
notes: Strict TDD RED: cargo test -p coven-pocket-ffi storage_root_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 produced 7 expected failures (missing-intermediate rejection, final-only mkdir/sync, rollback restart retry, iOS immediate-parent-only sync, and each-open parent sync). GREEN: focused storage-root tests 15/15. Full cargo test --workspace: 240 passed, 1 ignored; cargo check, clippy -D warnings, and fmt check passed. Code review found no significant issues. Commit 5b6a235.
close_reason: Implemented and verified structural existing-parent storage-root rule in 5b6a235

title: Resync storage-root parents after restart
description: Fix restart durability gap where failed parent fsync and failed rollback leave an intermediate root component whose uncertainty is lost with process-local state. Add strict TDD coverage and conservative no-follow parent-chain resync on every CheckedStorage::open.
close_reason: Implemented and verified restart-safe root parent-chain resync

title: Preserve offline Companion familiar selection
description: Fix Companion familiar profile derivation so stored pairings retain cached per-endpoint familiar selections while availability is idle, checking, or blocked; clear only on actual unpair and isolate endpoint/backend profiles. Add strict TDD coverage and run all requested gates.
close_reason: Implemented and verified offline Companion familiar profile preservation

title: Preserve stored sessions when listing fails
description: Fix ChatModel, modal sessions, sidebar sessions, and Spotlight lookup so list errors remain distinguishable from successful empty results. Retain cached summaries and Spotlight entries on failure, expose retryable UI errors, make overlapping refreshes generation-safe, and cover shared behavior with strict TDD.
acceptance_criteria: ChatModel storedSessions throws; shared modal/sidebar refresh retains prior state and skips Spotlight on failure; empty success clears and reindexes; overlapping refreshes are generation-safe; delete/fork reload through shared path; focused and full iOS gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified session-list error preservation, shared refresh state, safe Spotlight behavior, and mutation reconciliation.

title: Durably create storage roots
description: Fix walk_root_components so every newly created root component is durably published by syncing its validated parent, with rollback/error composition and retry behavior for uncertain durability.
design: Use a root-walk-specific no-follow parent sync helper because CheckedStorage is not canonicalized yet. Revalidate before parent open and after sync where feasible; sync each created component's parent immediately and always sync the configured root's accessible immediate parent during open.
acceptance_criteria: Fault-instrumented tests prove mkdir/parent-sync ordering, explicit parent-sync failure without artifacts, combined rollback errors and retry re-sync, symlink fail-closed behavior, and normal existing roots without privileged ancestor fsync; full Rust gates pass.
notes: Strict TDD RED: storage_root_ focused run had 6 expected failures (missing sync ordering, failure propagation, rollback retry, symlink pause, existing-root sync); intermediate rollback retry then failed independently. GREEN: 14/14 focused root tests. Full Rust workspace: 239 passed, 1 ignored; cargo check, clippy -D warnings, and fmt check passed. Commit 5f88714.
close_reason: Implemented durable root-component parent fsync, rollback/error composition, uncertain-component retry sync, symlink revalidation, and fault coverage in 5f88714

title: Migrate legacy empty session rows
description: Fix upgrade recovery for pre-marker zero-count SQLite session rows left by crashes before or during the first transcript append. Use bounded candidate-only migration, fail-closed path preflight, durable deletion for empty ghosts, and affected-session reconciliation for nonempty transcripts.
acceptance_criteria: Strict TDD fixtures cover missing, empty, partial-empty, valid nonempty, crash recovery, bounded reads, symlink safety, and active unindexed sessions; full Rust gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified bounded legacy zero-count session migration

title: Bound pending index records and recover oversized markers
description: Fix the oversized pending-index wedge. Add strict TDD coverage for deterministic oversized appends, direct pending-record bounds, safe oversized marker recovery, fail-closed marker types/names, and retryable recovery without unrelated scans.
design: Pre-serialize transcript lines before pending intent; derive/document an index-record bound from the largest valid transcript entry plus bounded metadata; preflight marker metadata and recover oversized regular UUID markers using transcript source of truth only.
acceptance_criteria: Oversized transcript entries are rejected before marker/index mutation; pending records are size-bounded at write; legacy oversized regular markers recover per affected session without parsing contents; unsafe markers fail closed; focused and full Rust gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented strict pending-record sizing, pre-intent transcript sizing, and safe legacy oversized-marker recovery; focused RED/GREEN and full Rust gates pass.

title: Preserve companion sessions across availability checks
description: Fix the confirmed generation/session-traffic bug by separating per-request availability fencing from stable daemon-instance traffic epochs. Add strict TDD coverage for same-instance refresh, overlapping checks, launch races, epoch invalidation, cancellation, polling retry, and cleanup ownership. Run all requested Swift test, lint, and build gates.
design: Maintain an availability request generation for stale publication and pre-adoption side-effect fencing, plus a traffic epoch advanced only by authoritative terminal identity-invalidating transitions. Bind adopted session traffic to epoch plus daemon identity.
acceptance_criteria: Same-daemon availability checks do not abandon adopted sessions; in-flight launch/send verification remains request-generation fenced; daemon identity/blocking transitions invalidate traffic exactly once; all requested gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified request-generation/traffic-epoch separation

title: Remove empty pending-index ghosts
description: Fix legacy recovery where a zero-count indexed session with a durable first-message pending intent and absent/repaired-empty transcript leaves an unresumable ghost. Add strict TDD coverage for empty and repaired transcripts, crash-safe deletion, restart idempotency, preservation cases, and new-protocol no-row behavior.
close_reason: Implemented and verified pending-index empty ghost cleanup in commit 53ddeb1

title: Fix incremental index publication ordering
description: Fix stale baselines when index.sqlite is recreated and prevent speculative zero-message session rows before the first durable transcript append. Add strict TDD coverage for resume, fork, pending recovery, post-append recovery, and existing-session failures.
acceptance_criteria: checked_index_store invalidation precedes baseline reads; first-message protocol is pending then transcript then session row then atomic message then pending removal; focused and full Rust gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented strict-TDD baseline invalidation and post-append index publication; focused regressions and full Rust test/check/clippy/fmt pass.

title: Recover message indexing incrementally
description: Replace routine full-history transcript reconciliation with durable per-session pending-index intents, checked recovery ordering, one-time legacy baselines, and strict crash/failure tests. Keep upstream SQLite behavior unchanged pending PR #172.
design: Use .session-lifecycle/pending-index versioned JSON intent records and .session-lifecycle/index-baselines durable per-session markers. Intent is durable before append, removed only after idempotent save_message; recovery preflights all records before mutation and runs after deletion/fork cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Routine list/create/unrelated delete performs zero transcript reindex attempts and does not scan unrelated transcripts; crash windows recover exactly once; malformed/symlink artifacts fail closed; deletion/fork ordering prevents resurrection; legacy reconcile happens at most once on resume/fork; Rust tests/check/clippy/fmt pass.
notes: Implemented durable v1 pending-index JSON intents and per-session index-baselines in rust/ffi/src/sessions.rs. RED evidence: routine no-scan test failed on unrelated transcript path; durable-append test failed because marker was absent; direct-delete test showed an unwanted index replay; reviewer regressions caught live-writer wedging, ghost first-intent rows, and stale baselines after index recreation. GREEN: full cargo test 198 passed/1 ignored; cargo check, clippy -D warnings, and fmt check passed. Known limitation: upstream coven-code PR #172 must make save_message insert/count transactional before the pin is bumped.
close_reason: Implemented and verified incremental message-index recovery

title: Canonicalize Apple storage root aliases
description: Fix ChatModel.sessionStoreURL so Apple /var, /tmp, and /etc aliases are normalized lexically to /private roots after Foundation symlink resolution, preserving custom symlink resolution and cross-platform compilation. Add strict TDD coverage and run simulator, lint, and build gates.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic /var/mobile maps to /private/var/mobile without filesystem creation; exact /var maps to /private/var; /Users is unchanged; custom symlink regression passes; /tmp and /etc aliases use component boundaries; all requested gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified Apple storage alias canonicalization

title: Keep companion launch results operation-local
description: Fix the confirmed stale-launch/global-session race where an invalidated send can reread a newer global session and clean it up. Add a deterministic lifecycle regression test first, then return the exact launched/adopted session from prepareAndLaunch and harden stale finalization cleanup by session ID.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic lifecycle test reproduces the race; active session B and all B context survive; A is killed exactly once; no stale A error/retry overwrites B; focused and full Swift gates pass.
close_reason: Completed with deterministic red/green lifecycle regression, operation-local launch outcome, session-ID/epoch cleanup guards, and passing focused/full Swift gates.

title: Resync absent fork marker during deletion retry
description: Fix pending-deletion cleanup so a retry durably re-syncs an already-unlinked pending-fork marker before acknowledging deletion completion.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test proves two injected pending-forks directory sync failures preserve the deletion marker until a successful retry; all Rust quality gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented strict-TDD retry resync fix and passed full Rust gates

title: Bind Companion traffic to verified pairing epoch
description: Fix the confirmed late-launch supersession race where a successful availability gate for daemon A remains usable after a newer availability publication for daemon B, blocked, unpaired, or checking. Apply strict token validity to launch, active input, polling retry, and cleanup without rerouting pinned sessions.
design: Introduce a small internal VerifiedPairing value containing the exact DaemonPairing and availability generation. Require operation generation plus token currency before and after every session side effect; stale returned launches clean through their original verified pairing while preserving newer availability and retry state.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic red-first tests cover endpoint and instance changes, blocked/unpaired/checking supersession, stale cleanup completion versus newer B launch, unchanged-token success, active send/poll/cleanup fencing, and existing cancellation/generation/dedup behavior; all requested Swift tests, SwiftLint, and simulator build pass.
notes: Strict TDD red: testReadyEndpointSupersedesSuspendedLaunchAndRetryUsesNewDaemon failed because session-a was adopted on daemon A, no kill occurred, polling started, retry context was nil, and later retry did not launch B. The complete new pairing-epoch suite also failed endpoint/restart/blocked/unpaired/checking, active input, polling response, cleanup side-effect, and stale-completion cases before production changes. Design: VerifiedPairing carries the exact DaemonPairing plus availabilityGeneration; all launch/input/events/current cleanup paths validate operation generation and token before/after suspension. Returned or pinned A sessions use a narrowly scoped known-session cleanup authority with A while current availability remains untouched. Green: focused Companion lifecycle/availability/polling/familiar plus ChatSurface/FamiliarSelection/CompanionPairing suites pass; full simulator tests, strict SwiftLint, generic simulator build, and git diff --check pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified pairing-epoch fencing for launch, active input, polling, and cleanup supersession races.

title: Make transcript indexing retry idempotent
description: Fix persist_new so durable transcript append progress advances before fallible SQLite indexing, pending stable index writes retry without re-append, and existing transcripts reconcile missing index rows on open/resume/list/recovery. Preserve fork/tombstone behavior and public ABI.
design: Transcript JSONL is source of truth. PersistState tracks append progress separately from queued stable index records. Drain pending index work at each persist_new entry, then append each message, advance transcript state immediately, queue/index by persisted UUID. Reconcile transcript entries into SQLite before exposing existing sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic index fault tests prove no duplicate JSONL lines or UUIDs across retries/restarts; reconciliation uses transcript UUIDs; failed appends do not advance state; all Rust tests/check/clippy/fmt pass.
notes: RED: one-shot retry produced 2 JSONL entries vs 1; second-message retry produced 3 vs 2; restart/resume count stayed 0 vs 1. GREEN: PersistState now separates durable append progress from queued stable UUID/role/text index work; every persist_new drains pending work first; create/resume/list/recovery reconcile actual transcript UUIDs; append is bounded, fsynced, rollback-safe, partial-tail repaired, and uncertain outcomes cannot generate a new UUID. Upstream INSERT OR IGNORE idempotency verified. Release gates: workspace 181 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored; cargo check, clippy -D warnings, fmt pass. Follow-up pocket-41m tracks upstream two-statement count atomicity.
close_reason: Implemented and verified strict-TDD persistence retry/reconciliation fix

title: Reject intermediate session-root symlinks
description: CheckedStorage currently validates only the final configured root, allowing an intermediate symlink to redirect storage outside the lexical root. Canonicalize the Swift application-support base before appending chat-sessions, then make Rust validate/create every root path component without following symlinks.
design: Strict TDD. Rust walks platform path components from prefix/root, rejects symlink or non-directory existing components, creates only one missing component under a validated parent, revalidates the complete path, then canonicalizes. Swift adds a small URL helper used by ChatModel.sessionStoreURL.
acceptance_criteria: Rust rejects existing intermediate symlink components before creating storage artifacts; Rust creates missing real directory components one at a time; Swift helper resolves application-support aliases before appending chat-sessions; focused and full quality gates pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified intermediate root-component symlink rejection plus canonical Swift app-support storage paths.

title: Recover cancelled polling retry state
description: Fix the confirmed retryPolling cancellation race where cancellation during a suspended events request leaves an active Companion session busy with no poll task or retry path. Add deterministic regression coverage and preserve generation fencing.
design: Use strict TDD. Add a suspended-events cancellation test first, then add generation- and cancellation-aware retry completion after every suspension without broad catches or test-only APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation after retryPolling refresh suspension retains the active pairing/session, applies no stale events/errors, clears busy, restores polling retry state, and starts no poll; stale generations cannot mutate newer state; focused and full gates pass.
notes: Strict TDD red evidence: suspended-events cancellation failed isBusy/retriesPolling/canRetry; completed-refresh cancellation failed retriesPolling/canRetry; blocked-gate cancellation failed terminal availability restoration. Green coverage includes active/missing session, stale generation, pending/completed outcomes, suspended and publication-time gate cancellation.
close_reason: Implemented and verified cancellation/generation-safe polling retry settlement.

title: Serialize pending companion cleanup ownership
description: Fix the confirmed duplicate-kill and stale-error race when reset/retry cleanup overlaps an in-flight cleanup. Add deterministic strict-TDD coverage for ready, blocked, and concurrent-join timing; serialize ownership before pairing awaits; revalidate identity after awaits; preserve cleanup semantics.
design: Use token/generation-safe cleanup ownership established before any suspension. Same-session retries join or return consistently; different-session work is not conflated; every post-await side effect revalidates pending identity and ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one kill for overlapping cleanup of the same pending session; late ready/blocked pairing results are benign after owner completion; concurrent retry preserves durable pending state while owner remains in flight; focused and related Companion tests, SwiftLint, and generic simulator build pass.
notes: Strict TDD red reproduced: each overlap issued one extra pairing call; ready paths killed session-1 twice; blocked path published stale blocked availability, error item, and canRetry. Implemented pre-await tokenized cleanup ownership with same-session joining and generation-aware sequential retry. All Companion suites, full simulator tests, strict SwiftLint, and generic simulator build pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified cleanup ownership serialization

title: Fence cancelled Companion session launches
description: A send Task cancelled after the availability gate can still launch or adopt a Companion session because the send/launch path checks only operationGeneration. Add deterministic regression coverage and cancellation fences, and clean any remote session returned after cancellation without adopting or polling it.
design: Use strict test-first development. Add Task.isCancelled checks alongside generation checks before side effects and after suspension. Cleanup late launch results with the verified pairing outside inherited cancellation while preserving existing pending-cleanup lifecycle and avoiding duplicate kill.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelled sends never launch when cancellation is observed before launch, never adopt or poll a session returned after cancellation, perform or retain cleanup, settle busy state, avoid user-facing launch errors, and allow a later uncancelled send. Focused and full Swift tests, strict SwiftLint, and generic simulator build pass.
close_reason: Implemented cancellation fences, uncancelled returned-launch cleanup, duplicate-kill protection, and regression coverage; all requested gates pass.

title: Serialize same-session chat resume
description: ChatModel.resume currently returns true for an already-active session before claiming the serialized operation slot. If another start/replacement is suspended, resume(A) can report success while B later replaces A.
acceptance_criteria: Add a deterministic ChatSurfaceTests regression test proving busy same-session resume returns false without engine resume; move the fast path behind claimOperation with balanced finishOperation; preserve stale-generation behavior; run requested Swift tests, SwiftLint, and simulator build; commit only this follow-up.
notes: TDD red: focused regression failed at ChatSurfaceTests.swift:942 with XCTAssertFalse because same-session resume returned true while replacement start was suspended. Green: focused tests, ChatSurfaceTests + FamiliarSelectionTests, full simulator suite, strict SwiftLint, and generic simulator build all passed.
close_reason: Serialized same-session resume behind operation claiming and verified deterministic replacement ownership.

title: Normalize configured storage root before symlink checks
description: Fix the confirmed review finding in f4ed00a: trailing separators or dot components cause symlink_metadata to follow the configured root symlink. Add strict TDD regressions for symlink/ and symlink/., reject parent components lexically, normalize without filesystem traversal, run Rust gates, and commit only the fix.
acceptance_criteria: Unix regressions fail red then pass; normalized absolute path is used for all root operations; .. is rejected; focused/full Rust gates pass; commit message matches request.
close_reason: Implemented lexical storage-root normalization with strict red/green symlink regressions and all Rust gates passing.

title: Reject session-storage symlink escapes
description: Implement the confirmed issue #12 storage-confinement fix in rust/ffi/src/sessions.rs. Centralize checked path handling, reject symlinks/non-files/outside paths, preflight destructive and recovery operations, cover Unix filesystem attacks with strict red/green TDD, run all Rust gates, and commit the verified fix.
design: Use a canonical checked storage root plus checked direct-child directories and checked regular-file leaves. Revalidate immediately before I/O/mutation, preflight all artifacts before index mutation, avoid following symlinks during cleanup, and document std path-based TOCTOU limits without adding unsafe or dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: All specified symlink escape tests fail before production changes and pass afterward; existing session tests pass; cargo test/check/clippy/fmt succeed; external sentinels and index rows survive failed destructive preflight; commit uses requested message and trailer.
notes: Strict TDD evidence: 15 symlink tests failed before production changes; delete and recovery preflight tests failed because index rows were mutated. Green: all 49 session tests and full 143-test crate suite pass (142 passed, 1 network test ignored); cargo check, clippy -D warnings, and fmt check pass. Code review found no significant issues.
close_reason: Implemented and verified checked session-storage confinement and destructive/recovery preflight.

close_reason: Implemented and verified queued prompt route invalidation and idle familiar explanation.

title: Make upstream SQLite message indexing atomic
description: The pinned coven-code SqliteSessionStore::save_message inserts messages and increments sessions.message_count in separate autocommit statements. A failure after insert but before count update leaves a stable UUID row with a permanently stale count because retry uses INSERT OR IGNORE. Fix transactionally upstream, then deliberately bump the coven-code pin here.
design: Implement the transaction in coven-code rather than forking engine behavior in coven-pocket. Keep message UUID idempotency and only increment count for a newly inserted row.
acceptance_criteria: Upstream save_message commits message insertion and count/update atomically; coven-pocket pin bump passes full framework and Rust gates; a fault test covers failure between the two writes.
close_reason: Completed upstream in OpenCoven/coven-code#172; merged commit 4521333d2cdc9b460c9c83bc9e6e1d906e7b3872 is pinned by coven-pocket commit 5e935db with atomicity regression coverage.

title: On-device /goal with Live Activity progress
description: /goal command driving the engine goal loop within iOS background limits; Live Activity progress; suspend/resume. https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven-pocket/issues/13
design: Reuse coven-code GoalStore and continuation semantics through new explicit-path APIs; Pocket FFI owns checked app storage, canonical session identity, bounded autonomous dispatch, and a goal-only GoalComplete registry. Swift owns exact slash-command parsing, main-actor state, finite UIApplication background-task pause/cancel, and a privacy-safe goal-specific ActivityKit extension.
acceptance_criteria: All documented /goal forms work on-device; cumulative durable progress survives restart; pause/resume/clear and budget/runaway stops are race-safe; background expiry and relaunch reconcile to paused; in-app and Live Activity progress stay typed and privacy-safe; session deletion clears goals and forks do not inherit; upstream engine change is merged and pinned; Rust/Swift/lint/framework/app/widget gates pass.
notes:
2026-07-31 triage: prerequisite pocket-dry is closed. The pinned engine includes GoalStore, GoalComplete, and continuation semantics, but desktop APIs use a global store path; Pocket will upstream a path-scoped reusable boundary rather than fork engine behavior.
Implementation split into four child beads: upstream engine boundary, Pocket Rust runtime, Swift/iOS presentation, and release hardening.

title: Daemon-owned Familiar companion
description: Expose the paired daemon Familiar roster in Coven Pocket, persist the selected Familiar per Codex or Companion profile, pin an exact identity snapshot to each new session, and preserve that identity across resume, fork, browsing, and Spotlight. Familiar identity never changes model, tools, permissions, or sandbox. https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven-pocket/issues/12
design: Use GET /api/v1/familiars as the roster authority. Send the exact familiarId on Companion launch and require an exact echo. On-device sessions inject the documented identity preamble and persist a bounded identity sidecar. Selection is profile-scoped; active sessions retain their original identity.
acceptance_criteria: Roster loading and selection work for Codex and Companion profiles; None remains available offline; identity is exact and session-pinned; launch authority is pairing-epoch fenced; persistence/recovery/delete/fork/index paths are durable and bounded; Rust/Swift tests, strict lint, framework build, simulator build, and holistic release review pass.
notes: Implementation completed on feat/familiar-companion. Fresh holistic review from merge base reports no Critical or Important findings.
